confidence_notes: Holistic model estimate, not based on live listings or current prices. Restaurant, café, and drink anchors are moderately reliable. Hostel and hotel anchors are less certain because July is peak season in Nice and rates vary widely (plausibly ±25% or more). Euro-denominated price levels were converted at an approximate 1.15 USD per EUR. The FX observation came from search-result summaries attributed to the RBA exchange-rates page, not a direct page read. A third-party site reported 0.6947 for 2026-10-16, so verify the official RBA F11 figure before relying on it.
comparable_city_reasoning: Based on general knowledge of Mediterranean French Riviera coastal cities with high summer tourism demand (for example Cannes and Antibes), adjusted for Nice's typically higher lodging and dining prices compared with Marseille or other French regional cities.
